design_status: pre-holdout; generated instances not yet evaluated
case_generator: Python random.Random seeded by a tuple-derived SHA-256 integer; data-independent IDs
experimental_units: 72 synthetic designed paths, crossed with two objectives. Equal 1/72 per path for each objective; same weight to missing/invalid baselines. Per-objective and all-path denominator; no population claims.
initial_contract_variants: Fixed closing stock at even seed index, minimum stock plus 35 USD/MWh closing stock credit at odd index. Discrete integer command blocks, one hour. Charge consumes five quarter-MWh to store one MWh. Discharge expends one MWh for four quarter-MWh. Grid import only, 0..grid cap, service continuously available up to per-hour request but metered in 0.25 MWh units. No export. Explicit per-hour integer reserve SOC floors, charge/discharge power and signed-command ramp; optional forced charge/discharge. Full deterministic forecast issued to all methods before planning. Scope is discrete scheduling, not physical continuous BESS.
baseline: Check idle or mandated seed commands; designate two fixed stress cells as missing and invalid on purpose (first seed tight reserve 24h missing; last seed negative outage 24h invalid). For other paths improve the full feasible schedule by exact local four-hour dynamic programs over two forward passes with offsets 0 and 2, keeping block-end SOC and exterior ramp viability; final window may use allowed terminal range. Lexicographic max service, min total cost. For economic screening hold each hour's delivered service exactly equal to this baseline and optimize the identical economic objective. Feasible profiles, exact witness checks and common full forecast compulsory.
service_target: at least max(1 MWh, 0.03 times baseline total shed MWh)
cost_target: at least max(20 USD, 0.03 times abs(baseline net cost USD))
stopping: Strict ceiling below target; equality remains a reachable target. Preserve absolute-only and relative-only sensitivities. No remapping null baselines. Retain maximal valid lower bound between tiers.
methods: contiguous interval energy plus signed-action ramp envelopes / energy-coupled import-price floor
full-horizon LP relaxation with exact boxed dual reevaluation
full discrete state dynamic programming with exact witness and Bellman replay
direct HiGHS MILP native bound plus checked integer primal
timing: Three within-case repeats rotating stage/direct MILP/direct DP, single solver thread, warmed per-arm workers; total time from receiving input to validated result (includes rebuilding baseline). Also record parent/worker invocation, init, RSS process maximum, solution/check time, full campaign elapsed. Soft decision deadline 0.5 s, external native solver limit 2 s; late results preserved. Frozen threshold; no timing superiority criterion across machines. Offline per-tier shadow audit runs all levels, separately from operational timings.
classification: Excluded, demonstrated (exact full-information feasible gain meeting target), unresolved, or invalid/missing baseline. Keep bound coverage distinct from feasible gains; no online-policy claims. Surplus ceiling over known exact discrete opportunity indicates relaxation/estimation looseness. Nonnegative frequency weights; keep invalid mass. Explain positive, equality, below-target and zero exact controls; intentional invalid/missing cases never earn credit.
controls: Two-hour constructive service benchmarks with improvements of 0, 0.75, 1 and 2 MWh, from idle baseline and sufficient cheap-hour charge power. Economic fixed-service controls give 0, 15, 20 and 40 USD, from idle delivery with zero wear under price spreads. Stronger absolute/relative threshold applies. Test corrupted SOC, flipped LP signs and substituted missing scenario as controls. Freeze and timestamp code and controls before holdout generation and access.
historical_regression: Replayed W05-A mechanism.py on W05 frozen 900 trial records before W06 case generation; byte-equal mechanisms.json SHA256 ac68bfcbf91ce7e40885b728b50a9cde01ccb4aaaefcead9f27e3f85a570f73e. W05 data are historical regression only.
implementation_note: No preprocessing, controller training or tuning on holdouts. A direct exact finite-state comparator is meaningful for these tractable quantized fixtures. CPU-time pricing is unobserved; compare clocks and break-even thresholds in their original units.
